preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 1000 for N in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For every test case, the integer N is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of test case inputs matches T.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= 1000 for x in line.split()) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Every integer in the output array is a positive integer within the range [1, 1000].

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line, N in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N integers corresponding to the input N for that test case.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(all(freq % 2 == 0 for freq in sub_freqs.values()) for sub_freqs in (lambda arr: [ {x: arr[i:j+1].count(x) for x in set(arr[i:j+1])} for i in range(len(arr)) for j in range(i, len(arr)) ])([int(x) for x in line.split()])) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: For every test case, no subarray exists where every element in that subarray appears an even number of times.

postconditions.expression: all(max([int(x) for x in line.split()]) == min_possible_max(N) for line, N in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: The maximum element in each output array is minimized among all valid arrays of length N satisfying the subarray condition.
